import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def p(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x,y,0)
def rectangle(sk,x0,y0,x1,y1):
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y0),p(x1,y0)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y0),p(x1,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y1),p(x0,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y1),p(x0,y0))
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get(); des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct); root=des.rootComponent
    pads=[('L1',7.50,-2.6075,1.40,0.30),('L2',14.197,-1.94075,1.40,0.30),('L3',5.3745,-7.40,0.30,1.40),('L4',19.3583,-8.00,0.30,1.40),('L5',7.50,-10.7275,1.40,0.30),('L6',16.6433,-12.9381,1.40,0.30)]
    made=[]
    for name,cx,cy,w,h in pads:
        s=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s.name='LEFT_GASKET_'+name; rectangle(s,cx-w/2,cy-h/2,cx+w/2,cy+h/2)
        feat=root.features.extrudeFeatures.addSimple(s.profiles.item(0),adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(0.80),adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.JoinFeatureOperation); feat.name='LEFT_GASKET_PAD_'+name; s.isVisible=False; made.append(name)
    if root.bRepBodies.count: root.bRepBodies.item(0).name='LEFT_CASE_BOTTOM'
    mgr=des.exportManager
    stl=mgr.createSTLExportOptions(root.bRepBodies.item(0),'/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/sage60_left_case_bottom.stl'); ok1=mgr.execute(stl)
    step=mgr.createSTEPExportOptions('/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/sage60_left_case_bottom.step',root); ok2=mgr.execute(step)
    print(json.dumps({'case':'left','gasketPads':made,'body':root.bRepBodies.item(0).name,'stl':bool(ok1),'step':bool(ok2)}))
